briefs.explicit:
MISSION BRIEF M-009
Units: metres, seconds, kilograms. Time starts at t = 0 when every robot leaves its start location.

Locations (x, y, zone):
- base: (0, 0), outdoor
- north roof: (126, -109), roof
- water tower top: (136, 104), roof
- workshop: (-79, -118), indoor
- storage hall: (94, -126), indoor
- fuel depot: (150, -34), outdoor
- transformer pad: (75, 108), outdoor
- parking lot: (56, 72), outdoor

Robots:
- D1 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 7.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1440 s, including the return to its start.
- D2 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 8.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1380 s, including the return to its start.
- M1 (mobile_manipulator): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 1.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 5 kg), robotic arm, camera. Endurance: 2940 s, including the return to its start.
- G1 (rover): starts at base. Drives on the road grid (travel distance = |dx| + |dy|) at 2.5 m/s; can reach outdoor and indoor locations, not roofs. Equipment: cargo carrier (max 25 kg), camera. Endurance: 4380 s, including the return to its start.
- D3 (quadcopter): starts at base. Flies in straight lines at 9 m/s; can reach outdoor and roof locations, not indoor ones. Equipment: camera, cargo carrier (max 2 kg). Endurance: 1380 s, including the return to its start.

Tasks:
- T1: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera.
- T2: Deliver the pressure gauge (9 kg) to workshop. Location: workshop. Duration: 60 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 9 kg). Deadline: finished by t = 300 s.
- T3: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera.
- T4: Replace the filter cartridge at workshop. Location: workshop. Duration: 330 s. Needs: robotic arm. Deadline: finished by t = 1200 s. Can start only after T2 is finished.
- T5: Inspect water tower top with a camera. Location: water tower top. Duration: 90 s. Needs: camera.
- T6: Deliver the cable reel (10 kg) to storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 30 s. Needs: cargo carrier (payload 10 kg).
- T7: Photograph parking lot for the condition report. Location: parking lot. Duration: 150 s. Needs: camera.
- T8: Collect a soil sample (1 kg) at fuel depot and keep it on board. Location: fuel depot. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm, cargo carrier (payload 1 kg).
- T9: Replace the filter cartridge at storage hall. Location: storage hall. Duration: 150 s. Needs: robotic arm.
- T10: Photograph workshop for the condition report. Location: workshop. Duration: 120 s. Needs: camera. Deadline: finished by t = 360 s.

Rules:
1. Every task is done by exactly one robot. A robot does its tasks one at a time, in the order you list them, travelling between task locations.
2. A robot can only do a task if it has the needed equipment, enough payload capacity, and can reach the task location.
3. A task that must start after another task waits until that task is finished, even if a different robot does it.
4. Each robot must be back at its start location before its endurance runs out.
5. Every task must be finished by t = 1500 s.

Objective: minimise the finish time of the last task (the makespan).
briefs.informal:
Hi team, here is today's job at the site.

Positions are in metres from the base at (0, 0). Drones fly straight and can't go indoors; ground robots follow the road grid (so they travel |dx| + |dy|) and can't get onto roofs. Everyone leaves their start spot at time zero.

Places: north roof (126, -109, a rooftop); water tower top (136, 104, a rooftop); workshop (-79, -118, indoors); storage hall (94, -126, indoors); fuel depot (150, -34, outside); transformer pad (75, 108, outside); parking lot (56, 72, outside).

The fleet: D1 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 7.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 24 minutes including the flight home. D2 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 8.5 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 23 minutes including the flight home. M1 is our mobile manipulator at base: gripper arm, camera, room for 5 kg, moves at 1.5 m/s and lasts 49 minutes including getting back. G1 is a rover parked at base that hauls up to 25 kg at 2.5 m/s and runs for 73 minutes including the drive back. It has a camera. D3 is a quadcopter at base with a camera; it flies at 9 m/s, can lift 2 kg, and its battery lasts 23 minutes including the flight home.

Jobs:
(T1) Have a look at water tower top - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T2) Workshop needs the pressure gauge, which weighs 9 kg - that takes 1 minute on site and it has to be finished within the first 5 minutes.
(T3) Get eyes on water tower top and check the panels - that takes 2 minutes on site.
(T4) Swap the filter cartridge at workshop - that takes 5.5 minutes on site but only once the pressure gauge (T2) has arrived and it has to be finished within the first 20 minutes.
(T5) Have a look at water tower top - that takes 1.5 minutes on site.
(T6) Get the cable reel (10 kg) over to storage hall - that takes 0.5 minutes on site.
(T7) Document parking lot with pictures - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T8) Pick up a soil sample at fuel depot and keep it on board; it weighs 1 kg - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T9) Change the filter at storage hall - that takes 2.5 minutes on site.
(T10) Grab photos of workshop for the condition report - that takes 2 minutes on site and it has to be finished within the first 6 minutes.

Everything has to be wrapped up within 25 minutes of the start, and the sooner the last job finishes, the better. Every robot has to make it back to where it started before its battery runs out.
